S에서 출발해 한 번에 위·아래·왼쪽·오른쪽 중 한 방향으로 한 칸씩 움: You start from S and move one cell at a time, each time in one of the directions up, down, left, or right. You cannot move outside the board or into a wall (#). D is a locked door. If you enter the K cell even once, you get the key, and you can enter the D cell only after getting the key. If you enter the E cell, you escape.

You start from S and move one cell at a time, each time in one of the directions up, down, left, or right. You cannot move outside the board or into a wall (#). D is an open door, so you can enter it at any time, like an empty cell. You also pass through the K cell like an empty cell, and nothing happens. If you enter the E cell, you escape.
판은 행 A~, 열 1~로 적는다. \"#\"은 벽, \".\"은 빈칸,: The board is written with rows starting from A and columns starting from 1. "#" is a wall, "." is an empty cell, S is the start cell, E is the exit, K is the key cell, and D is the door cell. A coordinate is written by joining the row and the column, as in "B2". Up is toward A, and left is toward 1.
S에서 출발하자마자 왼쪽으로 한 칸 움직일 수 있는가?: Right after starting from S, can you move one cell to the left?
S에서 출발하자마자 아래로 한 칸 움직일 수 있는가?: Right after starting from S, can you move one cell down?
S에서 가장 적은 이동으로 E에 닿으려 한다. 첫 이동은 어느 방향인가?: You want to reach E from S in the fewest moves. Which direction is the first move?
